# Parameters

[Project home](../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

**Source value** is the verified number from the author’s original work or cited literature, in the listed units. **Value used in this model** is the number actually applied in the simulation. **What changed and why** identifies the difference and documented reason. If the source is unavailable, the table explicitly says “Not established”; that value is an assumption, estimate or fitted value.

[Download the source-to-model parameter table](model_parameter_values.csv). Edit executable values in the Python files, save and run again.

## Editable parameters and applied values

- [activation.py](activation.py) — Activation and deactivation time constants governing how quickly excitation changes muscle activation. Values are in seconds.
- [APPLIED_PARAMETER_READBACK.json](APPLIED_PARAMETER_READBACK.json) — Parameter values read back from the assembled mechanical model, for checking what was actually applied.
- [ATTACHMENT_MAP.html](ATTACHMENT_MAP.md) — Readable map of muscle origins, insertions and intermediate routing points, with their body-local coordinates.
- [ATTACHMENT_MAP.json](ATTACHMENT_MAP.json) — Machine-readable muscle attachment and routing coordinates corresponding to the anatomical map.
- [attachments.py](attachments.py) — Muscle origins, insertions and intermediate attachment coordinates relative to the named bones. Changing a point changes the muscle path, length and moment arms.
- [bodies.py](bodies.py) — Body mass, center-of-mass location and inertia used in coupled skeletal dynamics.
- [contact.py](contact.py) — Paw-pad geometry, normal stiffness and dissipation, tangential stiffness and friction parameters used to predict GRFs.
- [environment.py](environment.py) — Environmental settings such as gravity and ground properties.
- [formulation_constants.py](formulation_constants.py) — Shared constants in the implemented activation, muscle–tendon and contact equations.
- [initial_state.py](initial_state.py) — Starting mechanical and internal states applied once when a forward run begins.
- [joints.py](joints.py) — Joint properties, including mechanical limits and passive stiffness or damping where specified.
- [muscle_tendon.py](muscle_tendon.py) — Per-channel strength, optimal fiber length, tendon slack length, pennation, damping and force-law settings. Units and source values appear beside the applied entries.
- [numerical_parameters.py](numerical_parameters.py) — Integration and sampling settings, including time steps and numerical tolerances.
- [PARAMETER_PROVENANCE.json](PARAMETER_PROVENANCE.json) — Verified source values, applied values, units and scientific attribution.
- [routing.py](routing.py) — Rules defining how muscle paths follow the articulated skeleton.
- [simulation_settings.py](simulation_settings.py) — Run configuration and fixed-excitation timing settings.
- [wrapping.py](wrapping.py) — Geometric wrapping settings where supported by the configured muscle paths.
